Opening your décor studio…

Good to know

A few things you
might be wondering.

How does this version work?+

It layers your selected decoration over your venue photograph. You control placement, depth, perspective tilt, size, rotation and opacity. Our 10 AI-created transparent cutouts are ready to place without background removal. Optional AI background removal is available for your own decoration uploads; it does not redesign your venue.

Do I need an API key or an account?+

No. Uploading, positioning and exporting happen in your browser. AI background removal downloads its model on first use and may take longer on mobile devices.

Can I use my own decoration photograph?+

Yes. Upload your decoration or choose a gallery concept. A transparent PNG is ideal. If a complex stage loses details during background removal, use the original photo or a prepared transparent cutout instead.

Are my photographs uploaded to a server?+

No. This editor processes photographs locally and does not send them to OpenAI or save them to a database. Model files are downloaded from IMG.LY when background removal is used. Clearing the editor or leaving the page removes its in-page photo references.

Will the decoration physically fit?+

The result uses a flat image with simulated depth and perspective. It is not a full 3D model or a measurement. Share your venue dimensions with Purple Fox before confirming an installation.
